subject: Sponsorship benefits slate + ops timeline / demo stage alignment
messages:
From: Kate Lewis <kate@summitworks.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan@summitworks.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Revised benefits slate + ops timeline (attached)

Hi Rafael —

Thanks for the call today. Attached is the updated sponsorship benefits slate (v3) and an initial ops timeline for the conference load-in, show days, and strike. Key updates from our side:

- Added a dedicated 20-minute demo block on Day 2 (afternoon session) for sponsors in the demo theater.
- Included 2 exhibitor-only networking passes for your demo leads.
- Slight downgrade to on-stage logo size in the keynote overlay (we tightened the layout to accommodate more partners).
- Clarified lead-retrieval options: RFID badge scans or QR-based lead capture (vendor: LeadGrab).

Files attached: RWD_Sponsorship_Slate_v3.pdf, Booth_Floorplan_20x20.png, Demo_Rider_Template.docx

Two quick asks for you before I lock this in:
1) Confirm you can commit to the 20 x 20 island footprint and demo rider requirements.
2) Do you need a hard AV line for interactive demos, or will wireless be sufficient?

If you confirm by EOD Wednesday we can get this into the exhibitor portal and push the invoice.

Best,
Kate Lewis
Partnerships Manager
SummitWorks Events
kate@summitworks.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Lewis <kate@summitworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised benefits slate + ops timeline (attached)

Thanks, Kate — good summary. A few clarifying points from our side:

- Booth footprint: 20 x 20 island is fine, but we need confirmation that the floor plan allows for a 10ft ceiling grid for the hanging sign. If not, we may reduce the hanging size.
- Demo stage: the 20-minute block works, but we need the slot placed in the 2:30–4:00pm window to avoid overlap with our customer Q&A reception. Can you propose exact slots?
- AV rider: we will require a wired ethernet drop for at least one demo machine (demo rigs do heavy on-site model downloads for warm cache). Wireless-only is risky.
- Lead retrieval: we prefer the RFID option but need access to raw CSV export of scans post-show (no vendor-only portal lock).

Looping in Marissa for branding/creative specs and Tessa for logistics and lead handling. Can you also confirm booth power (amps) and drayage deadlines?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Partnerships (West)
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Kate Lewis <kate@summitworks.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan@summitworks.com>, SummitWorks Event Ops <ops@summitworks.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised benefits slate + ops timeline (attached)

Rafael — quick answers inline:

- Hanging sign: the exhibit hall has a variable rigging grid; we can do a 10ft clearance in most locations but will need the exact booth coordinates to confirm.
- Demo slot: Preliminary schedule shows a 2:45–3:05pm slot on Day 2 open — is that acceptable? If you need 20 full minutes we can expand to 2:40–3:00pm.
- Wired ethernet: we can provision a single cat6 drop. Cost will be on the exhibitor invoice (standard rate).
- Lead exports: LeadGrab provides raw CSV export to exhibitor admin — we can specify that the CSV is shared with Redwood accounts by default.
- Power: Standard 20A 120V outlet included; higher amp requirements are available for an additional fee. Drayage cut-off is June 10 for discounted rates, June 16 is final arrival for on-site handling.

Ops is cc'd and will upload the confirmed coordinates and portal link once you accept the slate.

Cheers,
Kate

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Lewis <kate@summitworks.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised benefits slate + ops timeline (attached)

Thanks Kate — a couple of items from brand/creative: 

- Logo placement: if the on-stage overlay size is smaller, we need a vector EPS of the reduced lockup and a screenshot of the overlay mock to sign off. Our brand team will not approve pixel-only files.
- Booth creative specs: please confirm maximum backdrop height (we typically do 10ft but need to know if there are truss obstructions). Also confirm whether hanging signage must be produced by your official vendor or if we can use our trusted vendor (we can share insurance & W9).
- Demo rider template: thanks for the doc — we'll fill and return by Friday. Important: we will bring controlled demo content and require an isolated network segment for model downloads (is that supported?).

Sending over the RWD creative contact: Marissa Cole, Sr. Brand Manager, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Brand Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Exhibitor portal + install schedule (SUMMIT-EX-4832)

Hello team —

Portal: https://exhibitor.summitworks.com/portal/SUMMIT-EX-4832 (credentials were emailed to rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com)

Schedule highlights:
- Move-in (large freight): June 20, 07:00–17:00 (crane/rigging available only during these hours).
- Final carpet/lit install: June 21, 07:00–12:00.
- Show days: June 22–23, 08:00–18:00.
- Move-out: June 23, 18:15–23:59 (strict cut-off — late fees apply).

Insurance: General liability certificate with SummitWorks listed as additional insured required by June 15.

AV/Network: Cat6 drop will be scheduled on June 21 during final install; if you need an isolated VLAN, submit the Network Service Form in the portal and our network partner will follow up (additional lead time applies).

Attached: official floorplan with booth coordinate (Aisle 4 / Island C3) and exhibitor rules summary (see attachments).

Ops
SummitWorks Event Operations
ops@summitworks.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Lewis <kate@summitworks.com>, SummitWorks Event Ops <ops@summitworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exhibitor portal + install schedule (SUMMIT-EX-4832)

Kate / Ops — all good from Redwood. Confirming the following items so we have a single source of truth: 

- We accept the 20 x 20 island at Aisle 4 / Island C3. Please confirm rigging coordinates for a hanging sign at 10ft clearance by June 1 so we can place the order.
- Reserve the 2:40–3:00pm demo theater slot on Day 2 (extend to full 20 minutes if possible).
- Please schedule one Cat6 wired drop and open an isolated VLAN request; we submitted the Network Service Form in the portal (HubSpot deal_4832).
- LeadGrab: ensure raw CSV export is included on the exhibitor admin download post-show and add rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com and tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com as recipients.
- Creative: Marissa will send EPS files and overlay mock by EOD Monday; please confirm accepted file formats and vendor rules for hanging signage (we will use our vendor if allowed).
- Insurance: we will upload the certificate by June 12.

Next steps (internal): Marissa will finalize artwork, Tessa to book demo hardware freight, Grace to coordinate customer invite list for the demo reception. I'll approve the exhibitor invoice once the portal shows the confirmed rigging coordinates and demo slot.

Thanks — Rafael
